WHAT: The replacement of human laws with automated software rules.
HOW: It uses AI to enforce regulations and penalize behavior instantly without trial.
WHY: It creates a "rule by code" society where there is no empathy; nuance; or appeal process.

WHAT: The extraction of biological information from human bodies for profit.
HOW: It uses sensors to record heart rate; sweat; and eye movement to deduce health and emotion.
WHY: It commodifies your physical existence; turning your body into a raw resource for corporations.

WHAT: Programmable money that is fully traceable and controllable.
HOW: It relies on the ultra-low latency of 6G to process every single transaction globally in real-time.
WHY: It allows authorities to track every penny you spend and potentially "turn off" your ability to buy.

WHAT: A unified electronic ID required to access all public and private services.
HOW: It links your internet history; bank account; and health records into one unchangeable profile.
WHY: It creates a "checkpoint society" where you cannot move or act without digital permission.

WHAT: AI systems that infer your feelings from your face and voice.
HOW: It analyzes micro-expressions and vocal tones during calls or in public spaces.
WHY: It invades the sanctity of your inner mind; punishing or manipulating you based on how you "feel."

WHAT: A payment system that uses your face as the credit card.
HOW: It scans your facial geometry at checkout terminals connected via high-speed 6G.
WHY: It normalizes the use of your body as a corporate token and eliminates the option of anonymous cash.

WHAT: Identifying people by the unique way they walk.
HOW: It uses gait recognition algorithms on CCTV footage or radio wave reflections.
WHY: It allows for identification at a distance without consent; even if you hide your face.

WHAT: The monitoring of physical touch and movement through wearable suits or gloves.
HOW: It records the pressure; texture; and duration of your interactions in the Metaverse.
WHY: It captures the most intimate physical data; digitizing human contact into a surveillance metric.

WHAT: A network of devices connected to or implanted inside the human body.
HOW: It transmits real-time biological telemetry from pacemakers; pills; or implants to the cloud.
WHY: It turns human biology into an IT platform that can be hacked; monitored; or remotely shut down.

WHAT: The military concept of connecting every sensor and shooter in a warzone.
HOW: It uses 6G to coordinate drones; soldiers; and missiles into a single automated organism.
WHY: It accelerates warfare to machine speeds; potentially triggering conflicts faster than humans can stop.

WHAT: A function that allows authorities to disable devices or vehicles instantly.
HOW: It sends a high-priority command code through the network to brick a phone or stop a car.
WHY: It gives the state absolute physical control over your property and movement.

WHAT: The ability to pinpoint a device's location to within less than an inch.
HOW: It uses hyper-dense radio frequencies to triangulate position with microscopic accuracy.
WHY: It eliminates "approximate" privacy; revealing not just where you are; but exactly what you are holding.

WHAT: A virtual reality world owned and regulated by tech giants.
HOW: It replaces physical reality with a curated digital space optimized for ad engagement.
WHY: It traps human consciousness in a simulation designed to extract value and attention.

WHAT: The loss of mental privacy and cognitive freedom.
HOW: It occurs when Brain-Computer Interfaces begin reading and influencing neural patterns.
WHY: It threatens the last sanctuary of human freedom: the privacy of your own thoughts.

WHAT: The concept that the environment itself is always "watching."
HOW: It uses Wi-Fi and 6G signals to detect breathing and movement in a room without cameras.
WHY: It means there is no such thing as an empty room; the air itself is a sensor.

WHAT: Using data to arrest or investigate people before a crime occurs.
HOW: It feeds location and behavioral data into AI to flag "likely" criminals.
WHY: It destroys the presumption of innocence and targets marginalized communities with mathematical bias.

WHAT: The use of quantum computers to break current encryption standards.
HOW: It threatens to unlock all past and present private communications stored by governments.
WHY: It renders current privacy tools obsolete; exposing all secrets to those with the most power.

WHAT: A social system where access is based on a "score" of your behavior.
HOW: It aggregates data from social media; spending; and movement to rate citizens.
WHY: It creates a caste system where your ability to travel or work depends on compliance.

WHAT: A state-run scoring system that rewards or punishes citizen behavior.
HOW: It integrates surveillance cameras and financial data to blacklist "untrustworthy" people.
WHY: It enforces total social conformity through fear of losing access to society.

WHAT: The ultra-high frequency waves used for 6G data transmission.
HOW: It operates at frequencies that resonate with biological cells and water molecules.
WHY: It subjects the population to a massive; uncontrolled biological experiment with unknown long-term effects.

WHAT: The embedding of microchips into every everyday object.
HOW: It puts a computer and a radio in your toaster; clothes; and walls.
WHY: It ensures that no object is "dumb" or private; everything reports back to the mothership.

WHAT: Recording a 3D hologram of a real-world event or person.
HOW: It captures every angle and depth of a scene for playback in VR.
WHY: It allows history to be deep-faked; editing the 3D record of reality to suit a narrative.

WHAT: Using radio frequencies to cause physical pain or disruption.
HOW: It directs high-power beams to heat skin (Active Denial Systems) or disable electronics.
WHY: It turns the communication infrastructure into a potential non-lethal crowd control weapon.

WHAT: Using THz waves to see through walls and clothing.
HOW: It leverages the physics of 6G signals to image objects concealed underneath fabrics.
WHY: It effectively strips citizens naked without their knowledge or consent.

WHAT: Optimizing human workers like machine components.
HOW: It monitors employee eye movements and bathroom breaks to maximize "efficiency."
WHY: It reduces humans to robots; squeezed for every second of productivity via algorithmic pressure.

WHAT: A security model assuming no user is trusted inside or outside the network.
HOW: It requires continuous verification for every single action a citizen takes.
WHY: It treats every citizen as a potential threat until proven otherwise by their digital ID.
